item.title: Disney parks chief Josh D’Amaro will take over for Bob Iger as CEO

item.title: City of Wilmington postpones groundbreaking ceremony for Streetscape Project
item.description: The City of Wilmington announced that the groundbreaking for the Dawson and Wooster Streetscape Project has been postponed.

item.description: The City of Wilmington Parks and Recreation say registration is open for Spring Break Camp.

item.title: Community invited to attend youth recognition awards banquet
item.description: The City of Wilmington's Commission on African American History will host an awards banquet in February.

item.title: Welcome Home Angel looks to rebuild after fire damages offices
item.description: That's the worry, Welcome Home Angels executive director Craig Wagner has following a fire at the organization's offices located on Wrightsville Avenue.

item.title: ‘A minor miracle;’ Trained bystanders, AED save pickleball player at YMCA
item.description: A YMCA in Wilmington held a special ceremony on Tuesday for three of its members who helped save the life of one pickleball players.

item.title: Former volunteer firefighter charged with setting fires in Columbus County
item.description: A former volunteer firefighter in Columbus County is charged with setting fires.

item.title: Gov. Josh Stein discusses North Carolina’s winter storm response
item.description: Crews with the North Carolina Department of Transportation have made steady progress clearing highways and roads since a major winter storm affected the state this weekend, but some roads remain covered with snow and ice making travel dangerous.

item.title: Local man drives his 1923 Model T through the snow
item.description: You'd expect to see snowplows after a winter storm…but not this... it’s not a plow...it’s not a sleigh...it’s a 1923 Model T Town Sedan maneuvering around the snow and ice at Mayfair.

item.title: Wilmington City Council approves $1 million for new park, request for review of dredging project
item.description: The council heard details about a possible new park location in the 6300 block of Greenville Loop Road.
